text:
alex: Hey @runtime-team and @eng-security — PR 43921 needs runtime + security eyes before we can merge this week. Small change: opt-in eviction header + scheduler tweak. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/43921. Can runtime confirm perf impact and security confirm no KMS or auth regressions? Asking for signoffs by EOD Wed. cc @sophie @jamal

jamal: looking now, quick skim looks sane. one perf question: will this increase p99 for short seqs? i'll run a micro-bench and post results.

maria: scanning. main thing for us is ensuring audit logs + KMS usage unchanged. if code touches token creation path i need a scope check. sending a couple comments on the PR.

ops-bot: deploy-check: static-analysis passed, no secrets detected in diff, license check ok.

alex: thanks. TL;DR of change in case folks want a quick diff: ```diff
- "eviction_policy": "lru"
+ "eviction_policy": "lru_prefetch"
  // new header: X-RW-Evict: aggressive|normal
```

jamal: ran a short bench (see gist: https://gist.github.com/jamal/bench-43921). p50 unchanged, p95 +2-3ms for tiny batches, p99 within noise. comment added about atomic swap of header to avoid double-evict race.

maria: thanks @jamal. two notes from my side: 1) add a log line when header is present so we can trace evictions; 2) update compliance doc (internal link) mentioning opt-in header behavior. after that i'm happy to approve.

sophie: if runtime + security approve i can schedule merge Wed 15:00 PT and gate with canary rollout. want me to hold the merge window? :calendar:

alex: i'll push a tiny follow-up commit this morning with the log line and doc pointer. aiming to ping again before noon. Appreciate the quick reviews :pray:  

jamal: noted the atomic swap change in a PR comment — LGTM after that.

maria: added one inline question about masking the header in logs; otherwise i'll approve once the commit lands.

alex: will do a masked log and update PR in ~30m. thanks all! :thumbsup:
